messages:
maria (support): Customer reported SSE stream closed mid-token and client sees connection reset. Happens consistently after edge deploy (~2026-03-16T14:22:10Z). Ticket 3421.

dena (eng-runtime): Can you paste the curl they used and the X-Request-ID? Also which model + prompt length?

maria (support): Repro command they sent:
```
curl -v -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: r-cc3a1f" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","stream":true,"prompt":"<long prompt>"}'
```
Client saw two chunks then `data: [DONE]` but tokens truncated; client logs show ECONNRESET. x-request-id r-cc3a1f.

sre-oncall (sre): Metrics show spike in stream_disconnects at 2026-03-16T14:22:10Z on edge-us-east-1, proxy version 1.2.3, coincides with deploy.

jonas (eng-infra): Please attach packet capture. Look for sequence: who sends FIN vs RST and timing. Also include server trace id.

maria (support): Attached pcap excerpt — client sends FIN then proxy sends RST ~11ms later. Server had sent a small HTTP chunk just before FIN.
```
14:22:10.121 IP client > proxy: Seq=1000 Ack=2000 Len=512
14:22:10.125 IP proxy > client: Seq=2000 Ack=1512 Len=72  [HTTP chunk]
14:22:10.136 IP client > proxy: FIN, ACK
14:22:10.147 IP proxy > client: RST
```

dena (eng-runtime): Runtime logs for r-cc3a1f: `stream_eof=true` at 14:22:10.127 but final_chunk_bytes=72 and we don't see a `_stream_complete` marker. Need to check emitted_token_count and whether kv-cache persisted. Two theories: (A) client closed early (old SDK bug that closes socket on short idle), or (B) proxy reset when seeing FIN while backend still writing. We should validate backend produced all tokens.

maria (support): Customer mentions they're on iOS SDK v0.9.1 which had a premature-close bug — it would call close after 1.5s idle waiting for flush. They will try newer SDK as a mitigation.

dena (eng-runtime): Action items for runtime: (1) add `debug_stream_final_chunk=true` to logs for trace r-cc3a1f; (2) log emitted_token_count, final_frame_lengths, and whether decoder reached eos; (3) implement a defensive final-chunk flush + small delay before closing socket when streaming mode is active. I'll pick up 1+2 now.

jonas (eng-infra): Infra action: change proxy to avoid sending RST immediately on client FIN for active streaming backends — add 200ms drain window. Will canary edge-us-east-1 at 22:00 UTC and prepare rollback.

maria (support): I've updated ticket #3421 with pcap and suggested immediate step: ask customer to test with SDK v1.0.0 candidate. They're willing to test.

support-bot: Ticket #3421 status -> investigating. Owners: dena, jonas.

dena (eng-runtime): I reproduced locally by forcing client close `python repro/client_close.py --idle-timeout 0.1`. Runtime did produce trailing tokens but the socket close raced with last write. Proposed quick patch: ensure final write uses SO_LINGER or short sleep; also add detailed debug dump for a few traces.

maria (support): Can we deploy a runtime debug image to dedicated for the org to validate before we roll to hosted?

dena (eng-runtime): Yes — I'll push debug build to dedicated-42 and share creds. ETA ~6 hours.

jonas (eng-infra): Canary/update plan ready. Will monitor error budget and streaming metrics. If regressions, revert proxy tweak.

maria (support): Thanks — I'll follow up with the customer after they test SDK and again after dedicated debug image is available.
